headline: Late strike: Michael Olise scores winner to give France win in Belgium
summary: Bayern Munich star Olise came off the bench to secure a 1-0 victory, marking Zinedine Zidane's second consecutive win as head coach.
details: Michael Olise delivered a magnificent late goal in the 88th minute to secure a 1-0 victory for France against Belgium in the UEFA Nations League on Monday.
The Bayern Munich star entered the game as a substitute in the 77th minute, collecting possession in his own half and advancing to the edge of the box to curl a shot into the bottom-left corner.
This victory marks Zinedine Zidane's second win in two games since taking over as coach, following a 1-0 success against Turkey last Friday.
France now leads Nations League Group A1 with six points, three points ahead of Belgium and Italy.
The team played without captain Kylian Mbappe, who returned to Real Madrid for treatment of a left knee injury sustained during the match against Turkey.
Zidane made nine changes to the lineup, including debuts for Jeremy Jacquet, Lucas Da Cunha, and Esteban Lepaul.
Belgium, under new coach Mark van Bommel, made only two changes to their side after a 2-0 win over Italy.
Despite France's dominance in the game, the match was heading toward a goalless draw until Olise's late intervention.
France will next host Italy at the Stade de France this Friday, followed by a match against Belgium next Monday.
caption:
A substitute's magic! Michael Olise's late wonder-strike secures France's victory over Belgium.

Michael Olise delivered a magnificent late goal in the 88th minute to secure a 1-0 victory for France against Belgium in the UEFA Nations League on Monday.

The Bayern Munich star entered the game as a substitute in the 77th minute, collecting possession in his own half and advancing to the edge of the box to curl a shot into the bottom-left corner.

This victory marks Zinedine Zidane's second win in two games since taking over as coach, following a 1-0 success against Turkey last Friday.

France now leads Nations League Group A1 with six points, three points ahead of Belgium and Italy.

The team played without captain Kylian Mbappe, who returned to Real Madrid for treatment of a left knee injury sustained during the match against Turkey.

Zidane made nine changes to the lineup, including debuts for Jeremy Jacquet, Lucas Da Cunha, and Esteban Lepaul.

Belgium, under new coach Mark van Bommel, made only two changes to their side after a 2-0 win over Italy.

Despite France's dominance in the game, the match was heading toward a goalless draw until Olise's late intervention.

France will next host Italy at the Stade de France this Friday, followed by a match against Belgium next Monday.

headline_marked: Trump says [[US officials spoke with mediators]] to resolve Iran crisis
headline: Trump says US officials spoke with mediators to resolve Iran crisis
summary: Amid high tensions, Donald Trump reveals diplomatic efforts to ease the crisis, while maintaining a hardline stance on 'final victory' over Iran.
details: US President Donald Trump announced that American officials have been in contact with mediators to resolve the ongoing crisis between Washington and Tehran.
The announcement was made on Monday during a press briefing in the Oval Office of the White House.
Reports from Iranian state media indicate that Iran's Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi is also expected to attend meetings with mediators in New York.
These developments suggest an increase in behind-the-scenes diplomatic communication between the two nations.
Despite the diplomatic outreach, Trump maintained an aggressive tone, reiterating his claim that the US will soon achieve a 'final victory' in the conflict with Iran.
Trump also noted that global fuel prices have risen due to the current tensions and predicted that oil prices will normalize once the crisis is resolved.
caption:
Diplomacy or war? Trump reveals US officials are talking to mediators while still claiming a 'final victory' over Iran.

US President Donald Trump announced that American officials have been in contact with mediators to resolve the ongoing crisis between Washington and Tehran.

The announcement was made on Monday during a press briefing in the Oval Office of the White House.

Reports from Iranian state media indicate that Iran's Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi is also expected to attend meetings with mediators in New York.

These developments suggest an increase in behind-the-scenes diplomatic communication between the two nations.

Despite the diplomatic outreach, Trump maintained an aggressive tone, reiterating his claim that the US will soon achieve a 'final victory' in the conflict with Iran.

Trump also noted that global fuel prices have risen due to the current tensions and predicted that oil prices will normalize once the crisis is resolved.
